title: 第19章 听我解释第20章 今天也是和平的一天
lines: 格林追着血藤精跑了，剩下的埃莉诺用魔具简单给卡尔斯治疗了一下，等卡尔斯行动无碍后，两人一起离开了地下城。
至于格林？根本不知道他抱着露姆跑到哪里去了，拦都拦不住的那种。
他们或许可以和学院说不需要来这里历练了，格林再一直这样杀下去都没有怪物了。
那些学生说不定还会感到高兴，毕竟相当于少了不少作业，他们会感谢格林的。
afewmomentslater.（海绵宝宝转场音）
“抱得够久了吧，快点下来。
不然不给你魔核吃。”
格林表情有些严肃，刚刚在地下城还好说，但是现在已经找不到怪物了，也快到太阳升起的时候了。
他们马上就要到外面了，这样裸搂抱抱的成何体统？
“呜吖！”
露姆气嘟嘟的，变成一滩流动的液体跑到了地下，以鸭子坐的姿势坐到地上，然后张口了嘴巴：
格林满意的点点头，喂了一块魔核后，格林又掏出了埃莉诺给的衣服：“接下来再把衣服穿……嗯？你干嘛？”
露姆吃完魔核后再次变成一滩液体，爬回了格林身上，不过这次她是待在了背上。
因为史莱姆的特性，格林根本不能在不伤害露姆的前提下把露姆抓下来。
“我说，差不多得了，你这样黏着我是要干什么啊？自己下来动手可以获得的魔核不是更多吗？”
“呜嗯～”
“你不想下来？哈？连魔核都吸引不了你了吗？你这家伙。”
得嘞，先不管她了。
格林现在有更要紧的事情要做……
“厚礼蟹，我现在在地图的哪里？”
事实证明，即使有地图也容易迷路，这是真的。
早上10点，古兹在阳光下悠悠醒来，然后就准备去洗漱。
原本她是没有这个习惯的，但是在格林的要求下养成了。
“香香的软软的，抱起来才舒服。”
这是格林的话。
自己闲着没事想那家伙干嘛？古兹突然觉得有点苦恼，她似乎没有看到格林的身影，原本这个时候格林都会跑过来问她吃点什么的，然后顺便摸一下她的头。
自己则会生气把格林赶走，但是现在那个家伙还没有来，跑到哪里去了呢？
古兹洗漱完后下楼，发现格林还准备了早餐，但是是冷的饼干，看来是怕其他食物会坏掉。
估计早餐要自己热了，要怎么做来着？哦，对哦，格林教过自己了。
吃完早餐，古兹准备去做自己的工作了。
content_en:
Green chased the blood vine spirit and ran away. Eleanor, who was left, briefly treated Karls with a magic tool. After Karls was fine, the two of them left the dungeon together.
As for Green? I had no idea where he was running with Lum in his arms, and he was so unstoppable.
They might be able to tell the academy that they don't need to come here to practice. If Green keeps killing like this, there won't be any monsters anymore.
Those students might even be happy. After all, it means they have lost a lot of homework, and they will be grateful to Green.
…
afewmomentslater. (SpongeBob SquarePants transition sound)
…
"You've hugged me long enough, come down quickly.
Otherwise I won’t give you the magic core to eat. "
Green's expression was a little serious. It was okay to be in the dungeon just now, but now there are no monsters to be found, and it's almost time for the sun to rise.
They were about to go outside. How would it be appropriate to hug each other naked like this?
"Ugh!"
Lum was so angry that he turned into a pool of flowing liquid and ran to the ground. He sat on the ground in a duck sitting position, and then opened his mouth:
"Ah~"
Green nodded with satisfaction. After feeding him a piece of magic core, Green took out the clothes Eleanor gave him: "Put on the clothes next... hmm? What are you doing?"
After eating the magic core, Rum turned into a puddle of liquid again and crawled back onto Green, but this time she stayed on her back.
Due to the characteristics of slime, Green simply cannot capture Lum without harming her.
"I said, that's it. What are you doing by sticking to me like this? Won't you get more magic cores by doing it yourself?"
"Uh-huh~"
"You don't want to come down? Huh? Can't even the magic core attract you? You guy."
Come on, ignore her for now.
Green has more important things to do now...
"Housai Crab, where am I on the map now?"
It turns out it’s true that it’s easy to get lost even with a map.
…
At 10 o'clock in the morning, Guzi woke up leisurely in the sunshine, and then prepared to wash up.
She didn't have this habit originally, but she developed it at Green's request.
"It's fragrant and soft, so comfortable to hold."
These are Green's words.
What are you doing thinking about that guy when you have nothing to do? Guz suddenly felt a little distressed. She didn't seem to see Green. Originally, Green would come over to her at this time and ask her what to eat, and then touch her head.
I would be angry and drive Green away, but now that guy hasn't come yet, where has he gone?
After Guz washed up, he went downstairs and found that Green had prepared breakfast, but it was cold biscuits. It seemed that he was afraid that other food would spoil.
I guess I have to heat breakfast myself. How do I do that? Oh, yes, Green taught himself.
After breakfast, Guz was ready to do his work.
title_en: Chapter 19 Listen to my explanation Chapter 20 Today is also a peaceful day
